included_control_path: existing owner-chat production response path only, after owner-turn admission and before UMC-controlled actions
included_surfaces: Telegram direct owner chat telegram:8495203551 only
excluded_mutations: route/fallback/config production mutation outside the exact M10A flag
authority_boundary: M10A may only enforce PASS/HOLD/FAIL contract decisions for owner Telegram direct path before UMC-controlled actions; no broad production enforcement.
fallback_boundary: No fallback policy expansion; fallback must preserve contract envelope/receipts and fail closed on contract loss.
provider_model_boundary: No provider/model policy expansion; no provider/model calls outside the already-existing owner production response path.

contract_decision_behavior.PASS: Allow the existing owner direct response path to continue without enabling new action class.
contract_decision_behavior.HOLD: Block UMC-controlled action and return/record a safe hold classification; no send/probe escalation.
contract_decision_behavior.FAIL: Block UMC-controlled action, emit failure evidence, and trigger abort/rollback observation path.

operator_notification_behavior: Close-loop PASS/FAIL/HOLD/ABORT report to Stick in current owner channel after apply/observation; no extra Telegram probe.
